components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on paper: create trip, save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:40px; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:6px; border:1.5px solid transparent; background:#16213f; color:#fff; font:600 15px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform .12s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#24325c; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2a47a0; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action: choose, refresh, propose stops.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:40px; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:6px; border:1.5px solid #16213f; background:none; color:#16213f; font:600 15px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background:#e7eaf0; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2a47a0; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-quiet:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Ink Button

components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ink" style="--ink:#c8402a;--on-ink:#fff"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 8.5l3 3 7-7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/></svg> Scelto</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:40px; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:6px; border:0; background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); font:600 15px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2a47a0; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled field; label above in muted 13px.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; font-family:'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color:#565f73; } .ds-field input { min-height:42px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:6px; border:1.5px solid #aab2bf; background:#fff; font:15px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#19203a; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#707a8c; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:#16213f; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2a47a0; outline-offset:0; border-color:#2a47a0; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Sort and mode switches; navy outline, filled selection.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; border:1.5px solid #16213f; border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-seg button { min-height:38px; padding:6px 14px; border:0; background:none; font:600 15px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#16213f; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg button + button { border-left:1.5px solid #16213f; } .ds-seg button:hover { background:#e7eaf0; } .ds-seg button[aria-checked='true'] { background:#16213f; color:#fff; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2a47a0; outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Stop Chip
components.description: Rail entry per stop: oval, ink numeral pill, city name; active fills with ink.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:5px 13px 5px 6px; border-radius:50%/50%; border:1.5px solid var(--ink); background:none; color:#19203a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #eef0f2, inset 0 0 0 3px var(--ink); font:600 15px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-chip-num { display:grid; place-items:center; min-width:30px; height:26px; padding:0 5px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); font:800 17px 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 10%, transparent); } .ds-chip.is-active { background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ink), inset 0 0 0 3px var(--on-ink); } .ds-chip.is-active .ds-chip-num { background:var(--on-ink); color:var(--ink); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2a47a0; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Luggage Label Marker
components.description: Signature map marker; the active label is stamped (tilt plus offset print).
components.css: .ds-label { --tilt:0deg; position:relative; display:grid; justify-items:center; min-width:64px; padding:6px 14px 7px; border-radius:50%/46%; background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); border:0; cursor:pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--ink), inset 0 0 0 4.5px var(--on-ink); transform:rotate(var(--tilt)); transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-label::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; border:1.5px solid var(--ink); opacity:0; transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity .2s; pointer-events:none; } .ds-label:hover { --tilt:-2deg; } .ds-label.is-active { --tilt:-5deg; } .ds-label.is-active::after { opacity:1; transform:translate(4px,4px); } .ds-label:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2a47a0; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-label-num { font:800 22px/1 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-label-city { font:700 11px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Stop Tabs
components.description: Stop tabs; the selected label sits on a 4px ink underline over the navy rule.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:2px; padding:12px 16px 0; background:#eef0f2; border-bottom:1.5px solid #16213f; } .ds-tabs button { padding:9px 12px 10px; border:0; background:none; font:700 15px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#565f73; border-bottom:4px solid transparent; margin-bottom:-1.5px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color:#19203a; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { color:#19203a; border-bottom-color:var(--ink); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2a47a0; outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Status Tags
components.description: Pill tags for verification and state.
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:2px 9px; border-radius:999px; font:700 12px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.02em; border:1.5px solid currentColor; } .ds-tag-ok { color:#1f6b4c; } .ds-tag-warn { color:#6b4a05; background:#fbecc8; border-color:transparent; }

narrative.overview:
Valigia prints a trip the way a 1950s hotel printed its luggage labels: flat lithographic inks on cool paper, a navy shell, and one label per stop stuck on the route. Each stop owns one ink in travel order. Selecting a stop "stamps" its label on the map (a small rotation plus a misregistered second print run) and floods the stop header and active controls with that ink. The trip is collected as you plan it.

The working surface is a persistent console: a fixed-width panel of stop chips, tabs and sourced figures beside a full-height map that has been repainted in the app's own paper and ink. The density is a reference setting, not a brochure. Big condensed numerals act as handles (stop 01, price, score, day), and every figure sits next to its source.

Depth comes from print, never from light. Surfaces are flat ink, separated by 1.5px printed rules. The only offset in the system is the stamped active label.
keyCharacteristics: Navy shell, cool paper-grey working ground, six sequenced stop inks.
Ovals with a printed double rule (outer ink, thin inner hairline) as the signature form.
Big Shoulders Display 800 for numerals and uppercase place names; Hanken Grotesk for everything read.
1.5px rules carry structure; no blurred shadows, no glass.
A per-stop ink is set once as `--ink` / `--on-ink` and every ink-bearing part reads it.

rules.name: The One Ink Per Stop Rule
rules.body: A stop's ink is set once as `--ink` / `--on-ink` from the sequence and inherited; components never pick a stop color themselves. Ochre pairs with navy text, every other ink with white.

rules.name: The Quiet Frame Rule
rules.body: Navy, sheet and paper carry the interface; saturated color appears only as a stop ink or a status (warn, danger).

rules.name: The Numeral Handle Rule
rules.body: Numbers that a user scans (stop index, price, score, day) are set in the display face at 800; the units and qualifiers under them fall back to 12px Hanken in muted.

rules.name: The Uppercase Belongs To Places Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for display-face place and pane names, the wordmark, and the map label city line. Body and UI labels stay sentence case.

rules.name: The Print Not Light Rule
rules.body: No blurred or ambient shadows, no glass or backdrop blur. If something needs separation, give it a rule or an ink fill.

rules.name: The Single Stamp Rule
rules.body: The misregistered offset belongs to the one active stop label. Nothing else on screen is offset.

dos: Do take each stop's color from the ink sequence via `--ink` / `--on-ink`, cycling by stop index.
Do separate surfaces with 1.5px rules (navy for structure, Hairline Grey for list rows) instead of shadows.
Do set scannable numbers in Big Shoulders Display 800 and their units in 12px Hanken muted.
Do draw identity marks as ovals or pills with the printed double rule; keep working controls at 6px.
Do repaint any new map layer in the paper, water and navy values of the tinted basemap.
Do honor reduced motion: all transitions and animations switch off.
donts: Don't use blurred shadows, glass or backdrop blur; depth is print.
Don't put gradients on surfaces. The loading shimmer is the only gradient, and it is a loading state, not a surface.
Don't offset or rotate anything except the active stop label.
Don't introduce a stop color outside the six-ink sequence.
Don't set body or UI labels in uppercase; uppercase belongs to display-face place names and the label city line.
